result.summary: AC3 is insufficiently covered. Both TC-ELBP-03 and Playwright EO-005/AC3 verify that the page-size-error code path fires, but neither test asserts that the rendered message contains the limit value (200). AC3 explicitly requires 'a clear, readable message naming the limit, verified by a test.' A component rendering 'Page size too large.' with no limit number would pass all tests as written.

gaps.description: Mock error contains 'maximum is 200' but the only assertion is `expect(screen.getByTestId('page-size-error')).toBeInTheDocument()`. No assertion that the rendered element text contains '200' (or any limit value). Must add: `expect(screen.getByTestId('page-size-error').textContent).toContain('200')`.

Direct API assertion only checks `status === 400` plus absence of 'internal server error' — the limit value '200' is not asserted in the API response body. UI assertion is `toHaveText(/page size is too large/i)` which does not require '200' to appear. Must add: `expect(bannerText).toContain('200')` (or `toMatch(/200/)`) to the UI assertion.
